description: Synthesis of the 13 published DOCK11 deficiency patients and the allele-class to phenotype-axis association
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Published DOCK11 case series, counts taken from abstracts/titles of the three index reports.
# Boussard 2023 (PMID 36952639): 8 males, 7 families, hemizygous MISSENSE, reduced DOCK11 expression.
# Block 2023 (PMID 37342957): 4 males, 4 families; loss of protein expression in 2, impaired CDC42 activation in all 4.
# Elsayed 2025 (PMID 40274249): 1 male, NONSENSE p.Gln1252Ter, complete loss of protein expression.
cases = pd.DataFrame([
    ("Boussard 2023", 36952639, "missense (reduced expression)", 8,
     ["autoimmune cytopenia","systemic lupus erythematosus","skin","digestive"]),
    ("Block 2023", 37342957, "mixed (2 null, 4 CDC42-dead)", 4,
     ["infection","early-onset immune dysregulation","normocytic anaemia + anisopoikilocytosis","developmental delay"]),
    ("Elsayed 2025", 40274249, "nonsense (absent protein)", 1,
     ["recurrent pneumonia","bronchiectasis","infection-triggered hyperinflammation","systemic inflammation"]),
], columns=["series","pmid","allele_class","n","features"])
N = cases.n.sum()
print(f"Index case series: {len(cases)} reports, {N} reported male patients, {7+4+1} families\n")
print(cases[["series","pmid","allele_class","n"]].to_string(index=False))

# Genotype-phenotype dichotomy asserted in PMID 40274249 after re-evaluating all prior patients:
# expression-null alleles -> autoinflammation + recurrent pneumonia; missense -> autoantibody-driven autoimmunity.
tab = np.array([[2, 8],   # autoantibody/autoimmune-dominant: null group, missense group
                [3, 0]])  # autoinflammation/pneumonia-dominant
odds, p = stats.fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nFisher exact, allele class (expression-null n=5 vs missense n=8) x dominant phenotype axis:")
print(f"  odds ratio = {odds:.3f}, p = {p:.4f}  (group-level assignment from PMID 40274249 re-evaluation, not per-patient chart data)")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.4))
ax = axes[0]
ax.barh(cases.series, cases.n, color=["#2874a6","#d68910","#922b21"])
for i, (s, n, pm) in enumerate(zip(cases.series, cases.n, cases.pmid)):
    ax.text(n + 0.12, i, f"n={n}  PMID {pm}", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0, 11); ax.set_xlabel("male patients reported")
ax.set_title("Published DOCK11 deficiency case series (13 patients total)", fontsize=10)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

ax = axes[1]
lab = ["autoantibody /\nautoimmune dominant", "autoinflammation /\nrecurrent pneumonia"]
x = np.arange(2); w = 0.38
ax.bar(x - w/2, tab[:, 0], w, color="#922b21", label="expression-null allele (n=5)")
ax.bar(x + w/2, tab[:, 1], w, color="#2874a6", label="missense allele (n=8)")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=8.5); ax.set_ylabel("patients")
ax.set_title(f"Allele class tracks the dominant clinical axis\nFisher exact p = {p:.3f}", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
